title: Javanese Translations
description: Unofficial Javanese translations for Minecraft: Java Edition. Translations are done on Crowdin and anyone can contribute!
body:
(EN)
Initially, this resource pack was aimed to add the Javanese language translation project of Minecraft before its official addition in the official [Minecraft translation project on Crowdin](https://crowdin.com/project/minecraft). While we wait for its official in-game addition, this resource pack serves as an early look into how a Javanese translation of Minecraft would look like.

Note: Translations use the **Latin alphabet**, not the Javanese script!

As Javanese is now available in Minecraft's Crowdin translation project, **this resource pack will be discontinued once the language is officially available in the game**. If you'd like to help with the translation, you can do so via the [Nusantaran Minecraft translation project on Crowdin](https://crowdin.com/project/nusantaran-mc), but it is recommended to translate at the [official Minecraft translation project](https://crowdin.com/project/minecraft/jv) instead. We are currently looking for translators and qualified language proofreaders, if you feel that you are qualified to proofread the language, contact me ([@Dustin945](https://crowdin.com/profile/dustin945)) on Crowdin!

Part of the Nusantaran Minecraft project by NuruddinPlays.

(ID)
Awalnya, paket sumber ini bertujuan untuk menambahkan proyek penerjemahan bahasa Jawa untuk Minecraft sebelum penambahan resminya di [proyek penerjemahan Minecraft resmi di Crowdin](https://crowdin.com/project/minecraft). Sambil menunggu penambahan bahasa Jawa ke dalam permainan, paket sumber ini bertujuan sebagai pandangan awal terhadap terjemahan Minecraft ke dalam bahasa Jawa.

Catatan: Penerjemahan menggunakan **huruf Latin**, bukan aksara Jawa!

Karena bahasa Jawa sudah tersedia di proyek penerjemahan Minecraft di Crowdin, **pengembangan paket sumber ini akan dihentikan setelah bahasa Jawa sudah tersedia di Minecraft secara resmi**. Bila Anda ingin membantu menerjemahkan, Anda dapat melakukannya di [proyek penerjemahan Nusantaran Minecraft di Crowdin](https://crowdin.com/project/nusantaran-mc), tetapi saya lebih menyarankan Anda untuk menerjemahkan di [proyek resmi penerjemahan Minecraft](https://crowdin.com/project/minecraft/jv). Kami sedang mencari penerjemah dan pembaca pruf yang berkualifikasi, bila Anda merasa bahwa Anda berkualifikasi untuk menjadi pembaca pruf penerjemahan bahasa Jawa, hubungi saya ([@Dustin945](https://crowdin.com/profile/dustin945)) melalui Crowdin!

Bagian dari proyek Nusantaran Minecraft oleh NuruddinPlays.
